name: PTFE Expansion Joint
summary: Molded virgin PTFE expansion joints engineered for ultra-pure liquids, highly aggressive acids, solvents, and reactive chemical piping lines.
meta_description: PTFE expansion joints for clean, corrosive, high-purity, and chemically aggressive service where non-stick and chemical resistance are required.
key_features: 100% virgin PTFE construction provides total corrosion resistance against concentrated acids (HCl, H2SO4, HNO3), alkalis, and solvents
Non-contaminating, smooth non-stick inner surface prevents product build-up and complies with high-purity chemical standards
Low flexural modulus minimizes stress on delicate FRP, PVC, CPVC, and glass-lined vessel nozzles
Fitted with stainless steel tie-rods and limit washers to regulate axial compression, extension, and angular movement limits
Standard metallic root rings placed between convolutions prevent vacuum collapse and over-expansion under pressure
applications: Chemical synthesis plants, acid pickling lines, and chlorine/caustic electrolysis facilities
Semiconductor and electronic chemical delivery systems
Fertilizer and phosphoric acid production lines
Pharmaceutical API manufacturing and ultra-pure water distribution
Pulp bleaching operations using chlorine dioxide
materials: Bellows Body: 100% Virgin PTFE (molded or machined convolutions), optional antistatic conductive PTFE
External Root Rings: SS304 or SS316 stainless steel wire rings
Backing Flanges: Ductile iron, Carbon steel with epoxy coating, SS304, or SS316

PTFE Expansion Joint

Molded virgin PTFE expansion joints designed specifically for ultra-pure liquids, highly aggressive acids, solvents, and reactive chemical piping lines. PT Misuba Guna Indonesia delivers precision-molded multi-convolution PTFE expansion joints that offer complete chemical inertness across virtually all industrial media.

Engineered with a low spring rate to protect fragile plastic, FRP, glass-lined, or graphite piping systems from thermal movement and pump vibration, our PTFE joints feature external stainless steel limit bolts and corrosion-resistant steel backing flanges.

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

When inquiring about PTFE expansion joints for corrosive media, let us know your chemical fluid concentration, operating temperature, vacuum requirements, and mating flange standards. Our engineering specialists will verify convolution wall thickness and reinforcement rings for your operating conditions.
